title: Helmet HUD
teaser: Computer vision, soft-goods hardware, and materials testing for future EVA systems.
headline: An R&D prototype where object recognition and physical prototyping had to share the same future-facing brief.
challenge: Spacesuit work demanded equal comfort with materials testing, interface concepts, and embodied hardware prototyping.
outcome: Ali contributed across materials, helmet HUD recognition concepts, and soft-goods mechanisms for self-egress in a Mars suit cockpit context.
bullets: Trained computer vision models for object recognition integrated into space suit helmet heads-up displays.
Prototyped soft goods hardware for self-egress implemented in a Mars suit cockpit.
